lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.

lines: Us ke baad aaye jo azaab aaye
couplets.en: After that, let whatever grief may come.

lines: Aaye kuchh abr, kuchh sharaab aaye
couplets.en: Let a few clouds come, and a little wine.
Let the moon descend from the rim of the wine flask.
Let the sun come to rest in the cupbearer's hand.

lines: Kar raha tha gham-e-jahaan ka hisaab
couplets.en: I was counting the sorrows of the world.
Today you came to mind more times than I could count.
The rival's doors and rooftops blazed.
So it was whenever I arrived with my home in ruins.

lines: Goya har simt se jawaab aaye
couplets.en: It was as though an answer came from every direction.
